requirements.text: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp samples for a clear, indelible trade name or mark and type designation.

requirements.text: Where an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall either specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA, or provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Check the file contains an R37/R99/R128 approval number or a Technical Service report confirming the LED module is not mechanically interchangeable with such light sources.

requirements.text: If an ESA is (part of) a light source and the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. is missing, then approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
requirements.test_case: Verify the paragraph 3.2.10 documentation is present before R10 approval is granted.

requirements.text: For every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. shall be affixed to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Inspect production lamps for the R10 approval mark.

requirements.text: For each ESA conforming to the type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark shall be affixed on the ESA in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval mark location on the lamp matches the place specified on the communication form and is conspicuous and easily accessible.

requirements.text: The approval mark of the ESA shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mark for a circle with letter E and the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.text: The approval mark of the ESA shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mark for '10R-' followed by the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp EMC design and test results showing compliance with all applicable R10 requirements.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report covers radiated and conducted emission and radiated and conducted immunity tests of the lamp.

requirements.text: For broadband emissions, the electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband radiated emission of the lamp per Annex 7.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify broadband emission between 30 and 75 MHz is below 62-52 dBuV/m (E = 62 - 25.13 log(F/30)).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limit shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Verify broadband emission between 400 and 1,000 MHz is below 63 dBuV/m.

requirements.text: For the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare all measured broadband values with the limit line and confirm they are below it.

requirements.text: For narrowband emissions, the electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband radiated emission of the lamp per Annex 8.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Verify narrowband emission between 30 and 75 MHz is below 52-42 dBuV/m (E = 52 - 25.13 log(F/30)).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limit shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.test_case: Verify narrowband emission between 400 and 1,000 MHz is below 53 dBuV/m.

requirements.text: For the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare all measured narrowband values with the limit line and confirm they are below it.

requirements.text: The emission of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure conducted transient emission on the lamp supply lines per ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +75 V (Table 1).
requirements.test_case: Verify positive transient pulses generated by the lamp on a 12 V supply do not exceed +75 V.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be -100 V (Table 1).
requirements.test_case: Verify negative transient pulses generated by the lamp on a 12 V supply do not exceed -100 V.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +150 V (Table 1).
requirements.test_case: Verify positive transient pulses generated by the lamp on a 24 V supply do not exceed +150 V.

requirements.text: For vehicles with 24 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude of transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be -450 V (Table 1).
requirements.test_case: Verify negative transient pulses generated by the lamp on a 24 V supply do not exceed -450 V.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Confirm radiated immunity tests were performed with method(s) chosen from Annex 9.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a and the test severity for the minimum test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the applied immunity levels meet Table 2a over 90 % of the band and Table 2b over the whole 20-6,000 MHz band.

requirements.text: For the Stripline method, the immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 400 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 60 V/m (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the Stripline immunity test was run at 60 V/m over at least 90 % of 20 to 400 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the Stripline method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 400 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 50 V/m (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the Stripline immunity test level never fell below 50 V/m over 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: For the TEM cell method, the immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 200 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 75 V/m (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the TEM cell immunity test was run at 75 V/m over at least 90 % of 20 to 200 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the TEM cell method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 200 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 62,5 V/m (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the TEM cell immunity test level never fell below 62,5 V/m over 20 to 200 MHz.

requirements.text: For the BCI method, the immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 400 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 60 mA (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the BCI immunity test was run at 60 mA over at least 90 % of 20 to 400 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the BCI method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (20 to 400 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 50 mA (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the BCI immunity test level never fell below 50 mA over 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: For the ALSE method, the immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (80 to 2,000 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 30 V/m (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the ALSE immunity test was run at 30 V/m over at least 90 % of 80 to 2,000 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the ALSE method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (80 to 2,000 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 25 V/m (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the ALSE immunity test level never fell below 25 V/m over 80 to 2,000 MHz.

requirements.text: For the Reverberation chamber method, the immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (LUF to 2,000 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 21 V/m (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the Reverberation chamber immunity test was run at 21 V/m over at least 90 % of LUF to 2,000 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the Reverberation chamber method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA below 2 GHz (LUF to 2,000 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 18 V/m (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the Reverberation chamber immunity test level never fell below 18 V/m over LUF to 2,000 MHz.

requirements.text: For the ALSE method, the immunity test level for the ESA above 2 GHz (2,000 to 6,000 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 10 V/m (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the ALSE immunity test was run at 10 V/m over at least 90 % of 2,000-6,000 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the ALSE method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA above 2 GHz (2,000 to 6,000 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 8 V/m (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the ALSE immunity test level never fell below 8 V/m over 2,000-6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: For the Reverberation chamber method, the immunity test level for the ESA above 2 GHz (2,000 to 6,000 MHz) in over 90 per cent of the frequency band shall be 7 V/m (Table 2a).
requirements.test_case: Verify the Reverberation chamber immunity test was run at 7 V/m over at least 90 % of 2,000-6,000 MHz without degradation.

requirements.text: For the Reverberation chamber method, the minimum immunity test level for the ESA above 2 GHz (2,000 to 6,000 MHz) over the whole frequency band shall be 6 V/m (Table 2b).
requirements.test_case: Verify the Reverberation chamber immunity test level never fell below 6 V/m over 2,000-6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: While the tests are performed in accordance with Annex 9, the ESA representative of its type shall show no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" in order to be considered as complying with immunity requirements.
requirements.test_case: Monitor the lamp functions during Annex 9 tests and confirm no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The immunity of the ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 16750-2 starting profile and ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b to the lamp supply per Annex 10.

requirements.text: Where the ESA could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor, the starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the starting profile result is assessed with the ISO 16750-1 functional status classification.

requirements.text: For pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, the Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Verify pulse test results are assessed with the ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: Where the ESA could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines which are started with a 12V/24V starter motor, the ESA shall be tested with the starting profile at immunity test level II for 12 V systems and II for 24 V systems with 10 pulses, with functional status classification B for ESA related to immunity related functions which are to be operational during engine start phases, C for other ESA related to immunity related functions, and D for ESA not related to immunity related functions (Table 3a).
requirements.test_case: Apply 10 starting-profile pulses at level II and verify functional status B/C (immunity related) or D (not immunity related).

requirements.text: For test pulse 1, the ESA shall be tested at immunity test level -75 V for 12 V systems and -450 V for 24 V systems with 500 pulses, with FPSC III for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions (Table 3b).
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V) / -450 V (24 V) for 500 pulses and verify FPSC III (immunity related) or III (other).

requirements.text: For test pulse 2a, the ESA shall be tested at immunity test level +37 V for 12 V systems and +37 V for 24 V systems with 500 pulses, with FPSC I for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions (Table 3b).
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 2a at +37 V (12 V) / +37 V (24 V) for 500 pulses and verify FPSC I (immunity related) or III (other).

requirements.text: For test pulse 2b, the ESA shall be tested at immunity test level +10 V for 12 V systems and +20 V for 24 V systems with 10 pulses, with FPSC II for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions (Table 3b).
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 2b at +10 V (12 V) / +20 V (24 V) for 10 pulses and verify FPSC II (immunity related) or III (other).

requirements.text: For test pulse 3a, the ESA shall be tested at immunity test level -112 V for 12 V systems and -150 V for 24 V systems for a test duration of 1 h, with FPSC I for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions (Table 3b).
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) / -150 V (24 V) for 1 h and verify FPSC I (immunity related) or III (other).

requirements.text: For test pulse 3b, the ESA shall be tested at immunity test level +75 V for 12 V systems and +150 V for 24 V systems for a test duration of 1 h, with FPSC I for ESA related to immunity related functions and III for ESA not related to immunity related functions (Table 3b).
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V) for 1 h and verify FPSC I (immunity related) or III (other).

requirements.text: Where an ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, the ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.6.2. and with Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Check the LED driver circuit for oscillators above 9 kHz to decide if narrowband testing can be waived.

requirements.text: Where an ESA has no immunity related functions, the ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation and need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Assess whether the stop/position/reversing functions are immunity related functions before waiving Annex 9 testing.

requirements.text: The ESA approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7.
requirements.test_case: Test a production lamp against paragraph 6 requirements.

requirements.text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Measure a series lamp and verify emission levels are within limits + 4 dB.

requirements.text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Expose a series lamp to 80 % of the 6.8.2.1 levels and verify no observable degradation.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a component or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
requirements.test_case: Test a series lamp for conducted transient immunity (6.9.1 levels) and emission (6.7.1 levels).

requirements.text: The broadband emission test of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25, unless otherwise stated in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the broadband emission test follows CISPR 25.

requirements.text: While the broadband emission test is performed, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Operate all lamp functions (position, stop, reversing) at maximum load during the broadband test.

requirements.text: Where the ESA under test is involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the ESA under test shall be in charging mode.
If the current consumption can be adjusted, then the current shall be set to at least 80 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value for AC charging.

If the current consumption can be adjusted, then the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) for DC charging unless another value is agreed with the type approval authorities.
For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the broadband test used the CISPR 25 clause 6.4 ALSE set-up (or permitted OATS).

requirements.text: For measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS), the limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.test_case: Verify the broadband scan covers 30-1,000 MHz.

requirements.text: Where the measurements are performed with peak detectors instead of quasi-peak detectors, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied, since the limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation are for quasi-peak detectors.
requirements.test_case: Check the detector used and that a 20 dB correction is applied to peak readings.

requirements.text: For the broadband emission test, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested, unless otherwise specified.
requirements.test_case: Verify the LV harness faced the antenna during the broadband test.

requirements.text: For frequencies up to 1,000 MHz, the phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses.
requirements.test_case: Verify antenna phase centre alignment with the harness centre.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the broadband emission test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, except that, if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may divide the frequency range in 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz and perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the broadband test frequencies follow CISPR 12 intervals or the 14-band confirmation procedure.

requirements.text: If the limit is exceeded during the test, then investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
requirements.test_case: Where a limit exceedance occurs, verify it is caused by the lamp and not by background.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25, unless otherwise stated in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the narrowband emission test follows CISPR 25.

requirements.text: While the narrowband emission test is performed, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Operate all lamp functions at maximum load during the narrowband test.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test of the ESA shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the narrowband test used the CISPR 25 clause 6.4 ALSE set-up (or permitted OATS).

requirements.text: For the narrowband emission test, the measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Check the narrowband measurement used an average detector.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the narrowband emission test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, except that, if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may divide the frequency range in 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz and perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the narrowband test frequencies follow CISPR 12 intervals or the 14-band confirmation procedure.

requirements.text: If the limit is exceeded during the test, then investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Where a narrowband exceedance occurs, verify it is not background or broadband radiation from the lamp.

requirements.text: The ESA shall comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 9 being covered: (a) absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Verify the chosen combination of ISO 11452 methods covers the full 20-6,000 MHz range.

requirements.text: Where the ESA is in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the ESA shall comply with the requirements of the combination of the Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2 and Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4 at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these result in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 9 being covered.
For the immunity tests of Annex 9, the frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Confirm frequency range and general conditions follow ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: For the immunity tests of Annex 9, the test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Confirm immunity test conditions follow ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: While under test, the ESA shall be switched on and stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Switch on and stimulate the lamp functions in normal operation during immunity tests.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in Annex 9, unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test arrangement follows Annex 9 or the specific test method.

requirements.text: The immunity measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify immunity scan covers 20-6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 steps.

requirements.text: For the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth, unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify AM 1 kHz 80 % modulation is used from 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: For the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs, unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify PM2 (Ton 3 us, period 3,333 us) is used from 2,700 to 3,100 MHz.

requirements.text: For the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs, unless otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify PM3 (Ton 500 us, period 1,000 us) is used from 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: For the immunity measurements, the frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check step size and dwell time against ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the immunity test at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1, throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz, except that, if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may choose a reduced number of spot frequencies in the range (e.g. 27, 45, 65, 90, 120, 150, 190, 230, 280, 380, 450, 600, 750, 900, 1,300, 1,800, 2,360, 2,600, 3,000, 3,600, 5,200 and 5,900 MHz) to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the immunity test frequencies follow ISO 11452-1 intervals or the spot-frequency confirmation.

requirements.text: For the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Verify ALSE field calibration used the ISO 11452-2 substitution method.

requirements.text: For the absorber chamber test, the test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Verify ALSE immunity test used vertical polarization.

requirements.text: The TEM cell test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.test_case: If TEM cell is used, verify it follows ISO 11452-3.

requirements.text: For the TEM cell test, the Technical Service shall choose the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell, depending on the ESA to be tested.
requirements.test_case: Check the TEM cell coupling choice (ESA or harness) gives maximum field coupling.

requirements.text: The bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with either the BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or the BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, except that, as an alternative, the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Verify BCI testing per ISO 11452-4 with probe at 150 mm (substitution) or 900 mm (closed loop).

requirements.text: The stripline test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.test_case: If stripline is used, verify it follows ISO 11452-5.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: If reverberation chamber is used, verify it follows ISO 11452-11.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane, unless otherwise specified.
requirements.test_case: Verify the reverberation chamber setup includes a ground plane.

requirements.text: The test method of Annex 10 shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Confirm both transient immunity and transient emission tests are performed on the lamp.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses to the lamp supply lines and to connections operationally linked to supply lines.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp supply lines unless it is reserved for EVs only.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESA which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient emission per ISO 7637-2 on the lamp supply lines and connected lines.

requirements.text: Where an ESA is brought to the market as a replacement part without a type approval, the ESA shall be obviously marked as a replacement part by an identification number and be identical and from the same manufacturer as the corresponding original equipment.
requirements.test_case: For replacement lamps sold without approval, verify replacement-part identification number marking and identity with OE part.

requirements.text: Where a component sold as aftermarket equipment and intended for the installation in motor vehicles is not related to immunity related functions and has no type approval, the manufacturer shall issue a declaration that the ESA fulfils the requirements of this Regulation and in particular the limits defined in paragraphs 6.5., 6.6., 6.7., 6.8. and 6.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: For aftermarket lamps without approval, check the manufacturer declaration of compliance with paragraphs 6.5 to 6.9.

requirements.text: The ESA shall bear markings in conformity with paragraph 5.3., except that these markings need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the mark is on the lamp (visibility when installed not required).

requirements.text: Where an ESA is not switched, contains no switches or does not include inductive load, the ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7. and need not be tested for transient conducted emission.
requirements.test_case: Assess whether the lamp contains switching or inductive loads before waiving transient emission testing.

requirements.text: For the broadband emission test, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test to ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement.
requirements.test_case: Verify an ambient scan was recorded before or after the broadband test.

requirements.text: For the ambient measurement of the broadband emission test, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1., except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
requirements.test_case: Verify the ambient level is at least 6 dB below the 6.5.2.1 limits.

requirements.text: For the broadband emission test, the measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver with the parameters defined in Table 1 (spectrum analyser: 30 to 1,000 MHz, peak detector RBW 100/120 kHz at -3 dB, minimum scan time 100 ms/MHz; quasi-peak detector RBW 120 kHz at -6 dB, minimum scan time 20 s/MHz) and Table 2 (scanning receiver: 30 to 1,000 MHz, BW 120 kHz at -6 dB, maximum step size 60 kHz, minimum dwell time 5 ms for the peak detector and 1 s for the quasi-peak detector).
requirements.test_case: Check receiver/analyser settings against Annex 7 Tables 1 and 2.

requirements.text: Where FFT-based measuring instruments are used for the broadband emission test, the FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
requirements.test_case: If FFT receivers are used, verify continuous evaluation and at least 1 s per analysis band.

requirements.text: Where FFT-based instruments are used for the broadband emission test, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
requirements.test_case: If FFT receivers are used, verify continuous evaluation and at least 1 s per analysis band.

requirements.text: When a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements in the broadband emission test, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
requirements.test_case: Verify VBW >= 3 x RBW for peak measurements.

requirements.text: For the broadband emission test, the maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
requirements.test_case: Check the characteristic broadband reading per band is the maximum of H/V polarisation readings.

requirements.text: For the narrowband emission test, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test to ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement.
requirements.test_case: Verify an ambient scan was recorded before or after the narrowband test.

requirements.text: For the ambient measurement of the narrowband emission test, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1., except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
requirements.test_case: Verify the ambient level is at least 6 dB below the 6.6.2.1 limits.

requirements.text: For the narrowband emission test, the measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver with the parameters defined in Table 1 (spectrum analyser: 30 to 1,000 MHz, average detector RBW 100/120 kHz at -3 dB, minimum scan time 100 ms/MHz) and Table 2 (scanning receiver: 30 to 1,000 MHz, average detector BW 120 kHz at -6 dB, maximum step size 60 kHz, minimum dwell time 5 ms).
requirements.test_case: Check receiver/analyser settings against Annex 8 Tables 1 and 2.

requirements.text: When a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements in the narrowband emission test, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW).
Where FFT-based measuring instruments are used for the narrowband emission test, the FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
requirements.test_case: If FFT receivers are used, verify continuous evaluation and at least 1 s per analysis band.

requirements.text: Where FFT-based instruments are used for the narrowband emission test, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
requirements.test_case: If FFT receivers are used, verify continuous evaluation and at least 1 s per analysis band.

requirements.text: For the narrowband emission test, the maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
requirements.test_case: Check the characteristic narrowband reading per band is the maximum of H/V polarisation readings.

requirements.text: While the calibration phase is performed, any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place.
requirements.test_case: Verify no lamp support equipment was present during field calibration.

requirements.text: While calibration is performed, no extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point.
requirements.test_case: Verify no extraneous equipment within 1 m of the reference point during calibration.

requirements.text: When tests and measurements are repeated, the test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase, to ensure reproducible measurement results are obtained.
requirements.test_case: Check test equipment and layout match the calibration configuration.

requirements.text: Where the ESA under test consists of more than one unit and the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle are not available as interconnecting cables, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
requirements.test_case: If the lamp has separate units, verify vehicle harness or standard harness length to the AN.

requirements.text: If the ESA fails the tests defined in Annex 9, then the ESA shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
requirements.test_case: On any immunity failure, verify it occurred under controlled test conditions.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify after vibration exposure that the installed lamp retains its prescribed characteristics.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so fitted that it is not possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp mounting cannot be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road and parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, except that a tolerance of ±3° is allowed in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp relative to the road plane and median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: The light-signalling devices shall be fitted in compliance with any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp height and orientation on the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure left and right lamp positions for symmetry about the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, except that this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the exterior geometry of the left and right lamps for mirror symmetry.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of left and right lamps of each function.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this does not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric test results of the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: Where lamps incorporate a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the rear lamps for logos and their number and origin.

requirements.text: Where lamps incorporate a logo, the lamps shall not incorporate any logo that is not a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the rear lamps for logos and their number and origin.

requirements.text: For vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the requirements of paragraphs 5.5.1. to 5.5.5. for lamps constituting a pair shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Assess symmetry compliance as far as possible on an asymmetrical body.

requirements.text: Where lamps are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another, the lamps shall fulfil all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any.
requirements.test_case: Verify each grouped/combined/reciprocally incorporated function meets its colour, position, orientation, visibility and electrical requirements.

requirements.text: While all other functions with which a lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, the lamp shall fulfil its photometric and colorimetric requirements, except that, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions are to be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with the other functions switched OFF.

requirements.text: Where a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
Stop lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated with direction-indicator lamps.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the stop lamp is not reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator lamp.

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, any horizontal or vertical straight line passing through the projections of the apparent surfaces of these functions on a plane perpendicular to the reference axis shall not intersect more than two borderlines separating adjacent areas of different colour.
requirements.test_case: Check projected apparent surfaces of grouped stop and direction-indicator lamps for colour borderline crossings.

requirements.text: Where stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps are grouped, their apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, based upon the areas bounded by the outline of their light emitting surfaces, shall not overlap.
requirements.test_case: Check that apparent surfaces of grouped stop and direction-indicator lamps do not overlap.

requirements.text: Where a single lamp as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), has an apparent surface composed of two or more distinct parts, the single lamp shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements do not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the fill ratio (>=60 %) or gap (<=75 mm) of distinct apparent-surface parts of the lamp.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these lamps and/or apparent surfaces shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system, except that a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Classify the functions under the common outer lens as not forming an interdependent lamp system.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp height from the highest and lowest points of the apparent surface.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure height from the H plane when applying reduced visibility angles.

requirements.text: The position, as regards width, shall be determined from that edge of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is the furthest from the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle when referred to the overall width, and from the inner edges of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis when referred to the distance between lamps, except that where the position, as regards width, clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.test_case: Measure width position from the outermost and inner apparent-surface edges.

requirements.text: While the lamp is switched ON, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of the lamp shall not be intentionally varied, unless specific instructions are given.
requirements.test_case: Observe the switched-ON lamp for intentional variation of intensity, colour or apparent surface.

requirements.text: Where the photometric characteristics of any lamp vary (a) in relation to the ambient light, (b) as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or (c) when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, any variation in the photometric characteristics shall be in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Verify any photometric variation stays within the device regulation limits.

requirements.text: The red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check red rear lamp light is not visible from the front.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, the apparent surface of a red lamp shall not be directly visible if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4), except that this requirement does not apply to a red rearmost side-marker lamp.
requirements.test_case: Verify no direct visibility of the red apparent surfaces from Zone 1 at 25 m in front.

requirements.text: For the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, the apparent surface of a white lamp shall not be directly visible if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4), except that this requirement does not apply to reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings.
requirements.test_case: Verify no white light other than the reversing lamp is directly visible from Zone 2 at 25 m behind.

requirements.text: If there is doubt about compliance with paragraphs 5.10.4.1. and 5.10.4.2., then the requirement of paragraphs 5.10.4.1. and 5.10.4.2. shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Check red light emitted forward is <=0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the light switch and check rear position lamps switch ON/OFF simultaneously with the other listed lamps.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, unless one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Verify any deviation from simultaneous switching only occurs under the listed conditions.

requirements.text: The lamps shall not be concealed, except that the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the rear lamps are not concealable.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure reversing lamp chromaticity is white.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop lamp chromaticity is red.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position lamp chromaticity is red.

requirements.text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure retro-reflector colour is red.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count installed lamps of each function against the individual specifications.

requirements.text: Where a lamp is installed on movable components, the lamp shall fulfil the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.
requirements.test_case: If mounted on a movable component, check paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20 are met.

requirements.text: Where rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, are installed on movable components, the lamps on the movable components shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.test_case: Verify position, visibility, colour and photometry of tailgate-mounted lamps at all fixed positions.

requirements.text: Where rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors are installed on movable components and additional lamps for the above functions are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, the additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check additional lamps switched ON with the movable component open meet position, visibility and photometric requirements.

requirements.text: While the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on the movable components shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: Check lamps on movable components cause no undue discomfort in non-normal positions.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Cycle the movable component and verify the lamp returns to its specified position.

requirements.text: While any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, is in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use", the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of rear position lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by the movable component, unless this requirement is not practicable and the provisions of paragraph 5.21.1. or 5.21.2. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Measure the hidden fraction of the apparent surface in each fixed position of movable components.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable and the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamps or retro-reflectors is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component, then additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON, unless the provisions of paragraph 5.21.2. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify additional lamps switch ON when more than 50 % of the apparent surface is hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable and paragraph 5.21.1. is not applied, then a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.test_case: Check presence of the communication-form remark and user notice.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable and paragraph 5.21.1. is not applied, then a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users are to be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.test_case: Check presence of the communication-form remark and user notice.

requirements.text: For retro-reflectors, the provisions of paragraph 5.21.2. shall not apply.
requirements.test_case: Confirm retro-reflectors are not covered by the notice alternative.

requirements.text: If a lamp, even bearing an approval mark, cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse, then the lamp shall be deemed not to be present, except that this does not apply to retro-reflectors.
requirements.test_case: Verify each lamp operates with only light source and/or fuse installed.

requirements.text: If the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp fails and is temporarily replaced by a fail-safe replacement function, then the replacement function shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure and check the replacement function's colour, intensity and position.

requirements.text: If the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp fails and is temporarily replaced by a fail-safe replacement function, then the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Simulate rear position lamp failure and check the replacement function's colour, intensity and position.

requirements.text: While the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is temporarily replaced by a fail-safe replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a replacement and verify the dashboard tell-tale indicates it.

requirements.text: Where rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2. and are combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, the intensity of all these lamps shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Verify R2 and S2 intensities vary together in the same manner and proportion.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained in the entire intensity range throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop/position intensity ratio across the variation range.

requirements.text: When the luminous intensity of rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control is increased or decreased in relation to the following environmental conditions: (a) ambient lighting, (b) fog, (c) snowfall, (d) rain, (e) spray, (f) dust clouds, (g) contamination of the light emitting surface, the increase and decrease of the luminous intensity shall be in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations.
requirements.test_case: Verify intensity variation only responds to the listed conditions within the device limits.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, a decrease of the luminous intensity independent from the environmental conditions mentioned under paragraph 5.26.1. shall only be activated in the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations and as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m, except that as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h the intensity decrease already activated may remain active.
requirements.test_case: Verify traffic-based intensity decrease only at <=20 km/h or <=20 m and ends above 50 km/h.

requirements.text: While the luminous intensity of rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control is in transition, the lamps shall not show any sharp variation of intensity.
requirements.test_case: Observe intensity transitions of R2/S2 lamps for sharp changes.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, where a device indicated in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. has, according to its type approval documentation, been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the device shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage in constant-voltage condition against the approved voltage.

requirements.text: For all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage does not exceed 13.5 V +3 % on a 12 V system.

requirements.text: For devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128, the provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the LED lamp includes electronic control gear exempting it from the voltage limits.

requirements.text: The lamp shall be installed such that there is no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check for obstacles within the geometric visibility angles of the installed lamp.

requirements.text: When measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.test_case: Apply parallel-shifted observation when measuring visibility close to the lamp.

requirements.text: Where, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Provide photometric proof for the unobstructed part of a partially hidden lamp.

requirements.text: Where the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal is reduced to 5° (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit shall extend to at least 5° below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Verify the photometric field is only reduced to 5° below horizontal when the lamp is below 750 mm.

requirements.text: Where a LED module is not replaceable, the communication sheet of the component type approval shall state that the LED module is not replaceable.
requirements.test_case: Check the device communication sheet states the LED modules are non-replaceable.

requirements.text: Where applicable, all lamps (devices) installed on a vehicle shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify device approval markings for each lamp function.

requirements.text: Where a light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is incorporated, verify UN R148 approval of the lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Confirm a reversing lamp is fitted on the M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: For motor vehicles of category M1 and all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm, one reversing lamp device shall be mandatory, except that a second device is optional.
requirements.test_case: Count the reversing lamps fitted (1 mandatory, 2nd optional).

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check R23 or R148 approval marking for the reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned, in height, not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure reversing lamp height between 250 mm and 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned, in length, at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the reversing lamp is at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle α, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility 15° up and 5° down.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility angle β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, and 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility 45° left and right for a single reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the reversing lamp is oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the reversing lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Verify the reversing lamp lights only with reverse gear engaged and propulsion system operable.

requirements.text: If either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible, then the reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON.
requirements.test_case: Disengage reverse or switch off the propulsion system and verify the reversing lamp goes OFF.

requirements.text: Where required by the component regulation, a tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Check a failure tell-tale is fitted if required by R148/R23.

requirements.text: For all categories of vehicles, stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Confirm S1/S2 stop lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, stop lamp devices of S3 or S4 category shall be mandatory, except that this does not apply to chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space.
requirements.test_case: Confirm an S3/S4 stop lamp is fitted on the M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: For all categories of vehicles, the number of stop lamps shall be two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device.
requirements.test_case: Count two S1/S2 stop lamps and one S3/S4 stop lamp.

requirements.text: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check R7 or R148 approval marking for the stop lamp.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of S1 or S2 categories devices which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop lamp outer apparent-surface edge to vehicle edge <= 400 mm.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the stop lamp shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, except that the height may be up to 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop lamp height between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (2,100 mm).

requirements.text: Where the optional lamps are installed, the optional lamps shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.

For S3 or S4 category devices, the horizontal plane tangential to the lower edge of the apparent surface shall be above the horizontal plane tangential to the upper edge of the apparent surface of S1 or S2 categories devices.
requirements.test_case: Verify the S1/S2 stop lamp upper edge lies below the S3/S4 lower edge.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the stop lamp shall be positioned, in length, at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the S1/S2 stop lamp is at the rear.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the stop lamp shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify stop lamp horizontal visibility 45° left and right.

requirements.text: For S1 or S2 categories devices, the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the stop lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify stop lamp vertical visibility 15° up and down.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the stop lamp is oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: When the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H, all stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Apply the brake signal and verify all stop lamps light simultaneously.

requirements.text: When the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H, all stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously, unless the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.test_case: Check stop lamp behaviour with the propulsion system switched off.

requirements.text: Where required by the component regulation, a tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Check a failure tell-tale is fitted if required by R148/R7.

requirements.text: Rear position lamp devices of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Confirm rear position lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Count two rear position lamps and check R7/R148 approval marking.

requirements.text: The point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition does not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position lamp outer apparent-surface edge to vehicle edge <= 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, except that the height may be up to 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position lamp height between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (2,100 mm).

requirements.text: Where the optional lamps are installed, the optional lamps shall be placed at a height compatible with the applicable requirements of paragraph 6.10.4.1., the symmetry of the lamps, and at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
The rear position lamp shall be positioned, in length, at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the rear position lamp is at the rear.

requirements.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility 45° inwards and 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical visibility 15° up and down.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles where a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle and the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative chooses the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: If a rear side-marker lamp is fitted and the alternative is used, verify 45°/45° horizontal and 15° vertical visibility.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles where a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle and the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative chooses the alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: If a rear side-marker lamp is fitted and the alternative is used, verify 45°/45° horizontal and 15° vertical visibility.

requirements.text: For the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2., to be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: Measure unobstructed apparent surface >= 12.5 cm² excluding the retro-reflector area.

requirements.text: When determining whether the lamp provides an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the rear position lamp is oriented rearwards.
