requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that where a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Verify rear position lamp switching per paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps, combined with that of the front position lamps, shall be mandatory, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Verify a closed-circuit tell-tale combined with the front position lamps.

requirements.text: Where required by the component Regulation, a tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Check a failure tell-tale is fitted if required by R148/R7.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Confirm rear non-triangular retro-reflectors are fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Count two retro-reflectors and check Class IA/IB R3/R150 approval marking.

requirements.text: Where additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) are fitted, the additional retro-reflecting devices and materials shall not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Check additional retro-reflecting elements do not impair the mandatory devices.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure retro-reflector outer illuminating-surface edge to vehicle edge <= 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be positioned above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm, except that the height may be not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), or 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
requirements.test_case: Measure retro-reflector height between 250 mm and 1,200 mm (grouped).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be positioned, in length, at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the retro-reflector is at the rear.

requirements.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify retro-reflector horizontal visibility 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector shall be 10° above and below horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify retro-reflector vertical visibility 10° up and down.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Check the retro-reflector is oriented rearwards.

requirements.text: Where the illuminating surface of the retro-reflector has parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp, that other lamp shall be situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Verify shared surfaces of the retro-reflector are with rear lamps only.

requirements.text: A separate approval shall be required for each lamp listed in paragraph 1.
requirements.test_case: Check that a separate type approval exists for each lamp function (rear position, stop and reversing lamp).

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval shall be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify that each lamp of the combination lamp unit meets the provisions of this or another applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the combination lamp unit and confirm it contains no lamp that fails the provisions of all applicable Regulations.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp for which type approval has been granted shall be identified by the symbol R1 (steady) or R2 (variable), as listed in Table 1 (paragraph 5.2.).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the symbol R1 or R2 corresponding to the approved rear position lamp category.

requirements.text: The stop lamp for which type approval has been granted shall be identified by the symbol S1 (steady) or S2 (variable), as listed in Table 1 (paragraph 5.5.).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the symbol S1 or S2 corresponding to the approved stop lamp category.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp for which type approval has been granted shall be identified by the symbol AR (the letters A and R may be mingled), as listed in Table 1 (paragraph 5.8.).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the symbol AR for the reversing lamp.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Check the drawing and sample for a marking space large enough for the approval marking and other markings.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect all markings on the lamp for clear legibility.

requirements.text: For the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval marking and confirm it is at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking for the circled "E" followed by the country number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking for the four to six-digit sequential number of the approval number.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check that the sequential number is located close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking for the function symbols of each approved lamp.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking for "148R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments.

requirements.text: Where a lamp cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall consist of a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: For side-specific lamps, inspect the marking for a horizontal arrow indicating the mounting position.

requirements.text: For direction indicators categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Where a direction indicator is part of the lamp, check that the arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: For front or rear position lamps and front or rear end-outline marker lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check that the arrow on the rear position lamp points outwards from the vehicle when mounted.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps with reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps, the horizontal arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Where the reversing lamp has reduced light distribution for a pair, check that the arrow points outwards.

requirements.text: Where a lamp may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, the approval marking shall consist of the additional letter "D" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: For lamps usable in an assembly of two independent lamps, inspect for the letter "D" right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: Where a lamp is used as part of an interdependent lamps system, the approval marking shall consist of the additional letter "Y" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: For lamps of an interdependent lamp system, inspect for the letter "Y" right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: Where a lamp has reduced light distribution (see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3), the approval marking shall consist of a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: For lamps with reduced light distribution, inspect for the downward vertical arrow from a horizontal segment.

requirements.text: The lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the presence of the approval marking.

requirements.text: The lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the trade name or mark of the applicant.

requirements.text: The lamps shall bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed, unless the lamps have non-replaceable light sources.
requirements.test_case: For lamps with replaceable light sources, inspect for the marking of the prescribed light source category.

requirements.text: Where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), the lamp shall also bear a marking indicating the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s), unless the lamp has non-replaceable light sources.
requirements.test_case: Where approved for LED substitute light sources, inspect for the marking of the LED substitute light source category.

requirements.text: Where lamps have (a) an electronic light source control gear; and/or (b) a variable luminous intensity control; and/or (c) a secondary operating mode; and/or (d) non-replaceable light sources, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the LED lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range marking.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect each module for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module, comprising the starting letters "MD" for "MODULE" followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect each module for the "MD" identification code with the uncircled approval mark.

requirements.text: Where several non-identical light source modules are used, the specific identification code of the module shall be followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.test_case: Where several non-identical modules are used, check that each identification code carries distinguishing additional symbols or characters.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the approval mark on the light source module and the approval mark on the lamp in which the module is used shall be from the same applicant, except that the approval mark on the module does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the module and lamp approval marks and confirm they belong to the same applicant.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect each module for the rated voltage or voltage range.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect the lamp for the module identification code.

requirements.text: Where replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light source modules are used, inspect the lamp for the rated voltage or voltage range.

requirements.text: Where an electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control is part of the lamp but not included into the lamp body, the electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Where control gear is outside the lamp body, inspect it for its identification number and manufacturer name.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Check that the approval marking is on a part not designed to be separated from the light-emitting outer lens.

requirements.text: When the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened, the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp fitted on the vehicle (or the boot lid/door opened), confirm the approval marking is visible.

requirements.text: Where the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: If the outer lens is detachable, check that both the lens and the housing carry the approval marking.

requirements.text: Where an outer lens is used for several devices and bears different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Where the outer lens is shared by several devices, check that each main body bears only its own function approval marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and confirm the approval marking and the listed markings are affixed on it.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a) shall be affixed on the component (light source module).
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable modules are used, confirm the module markings are affixed on the module itself.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3. (a), 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. and 3.3.3.6. shall not be required to fulfil the requirements of paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Confirm only the approval marking (and LED substitute category, if any) is checked for visibility on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the single approval mark shall meet the conditions of paragraphs 3.3.5.1.1. and 3.3.5.1.2.
requirements.test_case: Where a single approval mark is used on the combination lamp, check that the conditions of 3.3.5.1.1 and 3.3.5.1.2 are met.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the single approval mark shall be visible after the installation of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, confirm the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check that no light-transmitting part (e.g. outer lens) can be removed without also removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the single approval mark components and compare with the smallest minimum size of the individual marks.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify by the approval test programme that each lamp function meets paragraphs 4 and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval, shall apply to the lamp under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 in force at the time of application.

requirements.text: Where verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible, the requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Verify the UN R48 requirements pertinent to each lamp and to M1 vehicles that can be checked at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: While in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which the lamps may be subjected in such use, the lamps shall be so designed and constructed that their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Perform a vibration test and confirm satisfactory operation of all lamp functions afterwards.

requirements.text: An assembly of two independent lamps to be type approved as lamp marked "D" shall only be applied to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check that a "D" marking is used only for the permitted lamp functions (not for the reversing lamp).

requirements.text: An interdependent lamp system to be type approved as lamps marked "Y" shall only be applied to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check that a "Y" marking is used only for the permitted lamp functions (not for the reversing lamp).

requirements.text: Where position lamps or daytime running lamps are reciprocally incorporated with another function using a common light source, the position lamps or daytime running lamps shall be designed to operate permanently with an additional system to regulate the intensity of the light emitted.
requirements.test_case: Where the position lamp shares light sources with another function, check the intensity regulation system operates permanently.

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall either (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Where rear position and stop functions are reciprocally incorporated, confirm multiple light sources or a failure tell-tale condition in the documentation.

requirements.text: Where, on request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components, the lamp (function) shall incorporate only one manufacturer logo.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is incorporated, confirm there is only one and that all function requirements are still met.

requirements.text: Where, on request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components, the lamp (function) shall fulfil all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation, except that, notwithstanding the requirements of paragraph 5.5.2. of UN Regulation No. 48, the logo light emitting surface (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) does not have to be symmetrical by itself.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is incorporated, confirm there is only one and that all function requirements are still met.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo, the logo shall, irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., be only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check that any incorporated logo is that of the vehicle or body manufacturer brand.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo, the applicant shall confirm by a statement (see paragraph 3.1.2.2. (f)) that the logo is only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check that the vehicle manufacturer statement confirming the logo is provided.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of the lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo in the reference axis direction and confirm it is at most 100 cm2.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the stop and reversing lamp sections and confirm no logo is incorporated.

requirements.text: Where a single lamp contains more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the LED wiring diagram and identify LED groups that are to be treated as one light source.

requirements.text: If any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source fails, then the lamp shall fulfil at least one of the following provisions: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and, when all light sources are illuminated, the maximum intensities are not exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case a note in the communication form states that the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: Disable each light source (LED group) in turn and verify minimum intensities are met or a failure tell-tale signal is produced; check maxima with all sources lit.

requirements.text: If the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1 fails, then the rear position lamp shall automatically fulfil the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control of an R2 lamp and verify R1 steady intensity limits are met automatically.

requirements.text: If the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1 fails, then the stop lamp shall automatically fulfil the requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control of an S2 lamp and verify S1 steady intensity limits are met automatically.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128 (provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval), and/or light source module(s), and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp design and confirm only permitted light source types (here non-replaceable LEDs) are used.

requirements.text: Where the lamp is equipped with replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light sources are used, attempt to fit them in incorrect positions and confirm this is impossible.

requirements.text: Where the lamp is equipped with replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, in accordance with the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable light sources are used, check the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet.

requirements.text: Where the lamp is equipped with replaceable UN approved light source(s) and a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the light source(s) holder shall in addition conform to the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Where LED substitute light sources are prescribed, check the holder against the corresponding IEC 60061 data sheet.

requirements.text: The Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform EMC emission testing of the LED lamp and confirm no disturbances causing malfunction of other vehicle systems.

requirements.text: Where the lamp is equipped with replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module can only be fitted in the designated and correct position.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable modules are used, attempt incorrect fitting and confirm the module only fits in the designated position.

requirements.text: Where the lamp is equipped with replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable modules are used, confirm the module cannot be removed without tools.

requirements.text: Where the lamp is equipped with replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that the light source module is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable modules are used, inspect the module design for tamperproof construction.

requirements.text: Where the lamp is equipped with replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), the light source module is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Where replaceable modules are used, confirm a UN approved light source cannot be fitted in the module position.

requirements.text: When a replaceable light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the device shall meet the photometric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and repeat the photometric test.

requirements.text: Where a lamp is equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric measurements with the LEDs fitted in the lamp.

requirements.text: The intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit, unless otherwise specified.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensities with the light sources continuously lit.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined, except that in the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators the limits of the light emitting surface are determined instead, and this requirement does not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.
requirements.test_case: Determine and record the apparent surface limits of each function in the reference axis direction.

requirements.text: For the operation of the lamp for testing, the voltage supplied at the lamp shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems), unless otherwise specified.
requirements.test_case: Supply the lamp at 13.5 V (12 V system) or 28 V (24 V system) during testing.

requirements.text: Where a lamp is controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated for testing as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp with its electronic control gear as specified by the applicant during testing.

requirements.text: Where a lamp that is not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control is equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), the lamp shall be operated for testing as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Operate the LED lamp as specified by the applicant during testing.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., unless otherwise specified.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at HV on both samples and compare with the function's minimum.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., unless otherwise specified.
requirements.test_case: Measure maximum intensity in all visible directions on both samples and compare with the function's maximum.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, unless otherwise specified.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities at the Annex 3 grid points on both samples and compare with the required percentages or values.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., unless otherwise specified.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity throughout the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles and compare with the minimum.

requirements.text: The intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall observe the provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity.
requirements.test_case: Check measured intensity distribution against the Annex 3 local variation provisions.

requirements.text: When the applicant requests an additional test to verify the visibility of red light towards the front and/or white light towards the rear of a vehicle required in UN Regulation No. 48, the maximum intensity in the angular field from 165° to 180° outboard in horizontal direction and -2.5° to +5° in vertical direction shall be not more than 2.5∙10^-1 cd (0.25 cd), except that this additional test may be conducted taking into account the influence of the vehicle body.
requirements.test_case: If requested, measure intensity in the 165° to 180° outboard, -2.5° to +5° field and confirm it is at most 0.25 cd.

requirements.text: When an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D" and having the same function, is deemed to be a single lamp and all lamps together are lit, the assembly shall comply with the requirements for maximum intensity.
requirements.test_case: For a "D" assembly, light both lamps together and check the maximum intensity.

requirements.text: If either lamp of an assembly of two independent lamps, to be type approved as lamps marked "D", having the same function and deemed to be a single lamp, has failed, then the assembly shall comply with the requirements for minimum intensity.
requirements.test_case: For a "D" assembly, switch off each lamp in turn and check the minimum intensity.

requirements.text: When all its interdependent lamps are operated together, an interdependent lamp system shall meet the requirements.
requirements.test_case: For an interdependent lamp system, operate all lamps together and verify all requirements.

requirements.text: Where the interdependent lamp system providing the rear position lamp is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant shall meet the outboard geometric visibility colorimetric and photometric requirement at all fixed positions of the movable component(s), except that the inboard geometric visibility requirement is deemed to be satisfied if this (these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the moveable component(s).
requirements.test_case: For a split interdependent rear position lamp, check outboard visibility, colour and photometry at all fixed positions of the movable component.

requirements.text: Where a lamp is equipped with a variable intensity control, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Sweep the variable intensity control over its range and confirm intensities stay within the paragraph 5 range.

requirements.text: For variable intensity control systems depending only on daytime and night-time conditions, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp under night-time conditions.
requirements.test_case: Under night-time setting, verify intensities do not exceed the steady category maximum.

requirements.text: For other variable intensity control systems, the variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities exceeding the respective steady luminous intensity maximum specified in paragraph 5. for the specific lamp under standard conditions (good visibility, meteorological optical range MOR > 2,000 m defined according to WMO, Guide to Meteorological Instruments and Methods of Observation, Sixth Edition, and clean lens).
requirements.test_case: Under standard conditions, verify intensities do not exceed the steady category maximum.

requirements.text: Where a rear position lamp and/or a rear end-outline marker lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously to the intensity of the rear position lamp or end-outline marker lamp when turned on alone shall be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities with stop and rear position lamp together and rear position lamp alone within ±5° V, ±10° H and confirm ratio of at least 5:1.

requirements.text: Where one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered shall be those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: Perform the 5:1 ratio measurement with all light sources of each function in operation.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Perform luminous intensity compliance tests following the Annex 8 procedure.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates within the Annex 3 light distribution grid of each function.

requirements.text: For checking the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied, except that for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates within the Annex 3 light distribution grid of each function.

requirements.text: Where lamps are equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics shall be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
Outside the field of the light distribution grid, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visually check outside the light distribution grid that no sharp colour variation occurs.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using different light source technologies, the colorimetric characteristics shall be checked for each light source technology separately according to the applicable provisions in paragraphs 4.8.1. and 4.8.2.
requirements.test_case: Where a function uses mixed light source technologies, measure colour for each technology separately.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4, except that a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (60 cd) is permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure both rear position lamp samples against Table 4.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp or rear end-outline marker lamp of category R1, MR or RM1 (steady) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd (4 cd) on the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), as given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure an R1 rear position lamp: at least 4 cd at HV, at most 17 cd (8.5 cd for "D"), and Figure A3-I distribution.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp or rear end-outline marker lamp of category R1, MR or RM1 (steady) shall have a maximum luminous intensity of 1.7∙10^1 cd (17 cd) when used as a single lamp or 8.5∙10^0 cd (8.5 cd) when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), as given in Table 4, except that a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (60 cd) is permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure an R1 rear position lamp: at least 4 cd at HV, at most 17 cd (8.5 cd for "D"), and Figure A3-I distribution.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp or rear end-outline marker lamp of category R2 or RM2 (variable) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 4∙10^0 cd (4 cd) on the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), as given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure an R2 rear position lamp: at least 4 cd at HV, at most 42 cd (21 cd for "D"), and Figure A3-I distribution.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp or rear end-outline marker lamp of category R2 or RM2 (variable) shall have a maximum luminous intensity of 4.2∙10^1 cd (42 cd) when used as a single lamp or 2.1∙10^1 cd (21 cd) when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), as given in Table 4, except that a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (60 cd) is permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure an R2 rear position lamp: at least 4 cd at HV, at most 42 cd (21 cd for "D"), and Figure A3-I distribution.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp or rear end-outline marker lamp of category R1, MR, RM1, R2 or RM2 shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 5∙10^-2 cd (0.05 cd) within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure the rear position lamp within the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles and confirm at least 0.05 cd.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the paragraph 4.6 failure checks on the rear position lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the rear position lamp and confirm it is within the red limits.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure both stop lamp samples against Table 7.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S1 (steady) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (60 cd) on the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure an S1 stop lamp: at least 60 cd at HV, at most 260 cd (130 cd for "D"), and Figure A3-I distribution.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S1 (steady) shall have a maximum luminous intensity of 2.60∙10^2 cd (260 cd) when used as a single lamp or 1.30∙10^2 cd (130 cd) when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure an S1 stop lamp: at least 60 cd at HV, at most 260 cd (130 cd for "D"), and Figure A3-I distribution.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S2 (variable) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (60 cd) on the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure an S2 stop lamp: at least 60 cd at HV, at most 730 cd (365 cd for "D"), and Figure A3-I distribution.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S2 (variable) shall have a maximum luminous intensity of 7.30∙10^2 cd (730 cd) when used as a single lamp or 3.65∙10^2 cd (365 cd) when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure an S2 stop lamp: at least 60 cd at HV, at most 730 cd (365 cd for "D"), and Figure A3-I distribution.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S1 (steady) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd (0.3 cd) within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure the S1 stop lamp within the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles and confirm at least 0.3 cd.

requirements.text: The stop lamp of category S2 (variable) shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd (0.3 cd) (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (0.07 cd) (night) within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure the S2 stop lamp within the Table A2-1 angles and confirm at least 0.3 cd by day and 0.07 cd by night.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the paragraph 4.6 failure checks on the stop lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the stop lamp and confirm it is within the red limits.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 10, except that, in the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd (25 cd) is to be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Measure both reversing lamp samples against Table 10.

requirements.text: Where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices and the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, a photometric value of at least 2.5∙10^1 cd shall be satisfied.

The reversing lamp of category AR shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 8.0∙10^1 cd (80 cd) on the reference axis (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), as given in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reversing lamp at HV (at least 80 cd) and at the Figure A3-V grid points.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp of category AR shall have a maximum luminous intensity of 3.00∙10^2 cd (300 cd) in or above the h-plane, 6.00∙10^2 cd (600 cd) below the h-plane, down to 5°D, and 8.00∙10^3 cd (8,000 cd) below 5°D (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), as given in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reversing lamp in and above the h-plane and confirm at most 300 cd.

requirements.text: Where the type approval of the reversing lamp is granted applying the condition that the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards, the reversing lamp shall only be installed in a pair, as stated in paragraph 9.1.3. of the communication form (see Annex 1).
requirements.test_case: Check the communication form states pair-only installation and that the vehicle installs the reversing lamps as a pair.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the paragraph 4.6 failure checks on the reversing lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reversing lamp and confirm it is within the white limits.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare production lamps against the approved type samples and approval documentation.

requirements.text: The compliance with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5. shall be verified as specified in paragraphs 6.1.1. to 6.1.3.
requirements.test_case: Check that the CoP verification plan covers paragraphs 6.1.1 to 6.1.3.

requirements.text: For the verification of compliance of the lamps with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5., the minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 4 shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Audit the manufacturer's CoP control procedures against Annex 4.

requirements.text: For the verification of compliance of the lamps with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5., the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 5 shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Verify that inspector sampling results meet the Annex 5 criteria.

requirements.text: For conformity of production, no measured value shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometric values on production lamps and confirm no unfavourable deviation exceeds 20 per cent.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12 (required minimum value / equivalent 20 per cent / equivalent 30 per cent): 7∙10-1 cd / 5∙10-1 cd / 3∙10-1 cd; 6∙10-1 cd / 4∙10-1 cd / 2∙10-1 cd; 3∙10-1 cd / 2∙10-1 cd / 1∙10-1 cd; 7∙10-2 cd / 5∙10-2 cd / 3∙10-2 cd; 5∙10-2 cd / 3∙10-2 cd / 2∙10-2 cd.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured low minimum values in the Annex 2 and 3 fields with the Table 12 CoP values.

requirements.text: If doubt exists in respect to compliance of the non-replaceable filament light source(s) with lifetime requirements and/or, in the case of colour coated filament light sources, with colour endurance requirements, as specified in paragraph 4.11. of IEC 60809, Edition 4, then conformity shall be checked as specified in paragraph 4.11 of IEC 60809, Edition 4.
requirements.test_case: In case of doubt, perform the lifetime check of paragraph 4.11 of IEC 60809, Edition 4 on the non-replaceable filament light sources.

requirements.text: The front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard, as given in Table A2-1, except that reduced angles of 20° inboard / 80° outboard may be used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the horizontal geometric visibility of the rear position lamp and confirm 45°/80° (20°/80° below the H-plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1, except that for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm the minimum vertical angles may be 15° above / 5° below, and for optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm the minimum vertical angles may be 5° above / 15° below.
requirements.test_case: Measure the vertical geometric visibility of the rear position lamp and confirm 15°/15° (15°/5° if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The stop lamps (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 45° outboard, as given in Table A2-1, except that reduced angles of 20° inboard / 45° outboard may be used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the horizontal geometric visibility of the stop lamp and confirm 45°/45° (20°/45° below the H-plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The stop lamps (S1, S2) shall have minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below, as given in Table A2-1, except that for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm the minimum vertical angles may be 15° above / 5° below, and for optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm the minimum vertical angles may be 5° above / 15° below.
requirements.test_case: Measure the vertical geometric visibility of the stop lamp and confirm 15°/15° (15°/5° if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The direction H = 0° and V = 0° shall correspond to the reference axis, which on the vehicle is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle and oriented in the required direction of visibility, and which passes through the centre of reference.
requirements.test_case: Check that the photometric goniometer set-up aligns H = 0°, V = 0° with the lamp reference axis through the centre of reference.

requirements.text: The minimum intensities given, for the various directions of measurement, by the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV as a percentage of the minimum intensities required shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits, unless specified otherwise, except that in the case where front and rear direction indicator lamps, front and rear position lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, parking lamps, stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS, or side marker lamps are intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Recalculate the point minimum intensities as percentages of the required minimum, rounded down to three significant digits, and compare with measurements.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage, so that the light pattern is substantially uniform, except that, in the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check is made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities between grid points and confirm each meets the lowest surrounding grid-line minimum.

requirements.text: If, in the case of reversing lamps, visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, then a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.

The front and rear position lamps, parking lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS) and direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c, 12 shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, in which the values shown give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
requirements.test_case: Measure the rear position and stop lamp at all Figure A3-I points and confirm the minimum percentages of the required minimum intensity.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall provide, at the measuring points expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference (H = 0° and V = 0°, horizontal on the vehicle, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, oriented in the required direction of visibility and passing through the centre of reference), at least the minimum intensities in cd shown in Figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reversing lamp at all Figure A3-V points and confirm the minimum intensities in cd.

requirements.text: For the conformity requirements to be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, the differences shall not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect production lamps dimensionally and confirm deviations are within inevitable manufacturing deviations.

requirements.text: When testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested with respect to photometric performances.
requirements.test_case: Test the photometry of a randomly chosen production lamp according to paragraph 4.8.

requirements.text: If the results of the photometric test of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source do not meet the requirements, then the tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
requirements.test_case: If a lamp with a replaceable light source fails photometry, repeat the test with another standard light source.

requirements.text: When tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation, the lamp shall comply with the chromaticity coordinates.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of production lamps under paragraph 4.9 conditions.

requirements.text: For each type of lamp, the holder of the type approval shall carry out at least the tests specified in paragraph 2. of Annex 4 at appropriate intervals.
requirements.test_case: Review the CoP test records for each lamp type and the test intervals.

requirements.text: The holder of the type approval shall carry out the conformity of production tests in accordance with the provisions of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check that CoP test methods follow the provisions of UN R148.

requirements.text: If any sampling shows non-conformity with regard to the type of test concerned, then the holder of the type approval shall take and test further samples.
requirements.test_case: Verify that non-conforming CoP results trigger additional sampling and testing.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall take steps to ensure the conformity of the production concerned.
requirements.test_case: Review corrective actions taken after a non-conforming CoP result.

requirements.text: The tests of conformity shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics.
requirements.test_case: Confirm CoP testing includes both photometric and colorimetric measurements.

requirements.text: The holder of the type approval shall generally carry out the conformity of production tests in accordance with the methods set out in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the CoP test methods against those of UN R148.

requirements.text: The sampled lamp shall be subjected to photometric measurements for the minimum values at the points listed in Annex 3 and the required chromaticity coordinates.
requirements.test_case: Measure the sampled lamp at the Annex 3 points and its chromaticity coordinates.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall carry out a statistical study of the test results in order to meet the requirements laid down for verification of conformity of products in paragraph 6.1. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the statistical study and agreed acceptance criteria.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall define, in agreement with the competent authority, criteria governing the acceptability of his products in order to meet the requirements laid down for verification of conformity of products in paragraph 6.1. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the statistical study and agreed acceptance criteria.

requirements.text: The criteria governing the acceptability shall be such that, with a confidence level of 95 per cent, the minimum probability of passing a spot check in accordance with Annex 5 would be 0.95.
requirements.test_case: Verify statistically that the acceptance criteria give at least 0.95 probability of passing an Annex 5 spot check at 95 per cent confidence.

requirements.text: When testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested with respect to photometric performance if no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Test a randomly chosen production lamp and compare the deviations with paragraph 6.1.3.

requirements.text: If, in the case of a lamp equipped with a replaceable light source, the results of the photometric test do not meet the requirements, then the tests on lamps shall be repeated using another standard light source.
For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: For an incandescent function, measure intensities after photometric stability and compare with the minimum and maximum values.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements, except that the luminous intensity distribution after 1 and after 10 minutes of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured after photometric stability has occurred by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 minute, after 10 minutes and after photometric stability has occurred.
requirements.test_case: Measure the LED reversing lamp after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation and compare with the minimum and maximum values.

requirements.text: For all other lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements, except that the luminous intensity distribution after 1 min of operation may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization, by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at HV after 1 min and either after 30 min of operation or after photometric stabilization.
requirements.test_case: Measure the LED rear position and stop lamps after 1 min and after 30 min or photometric stability and compare with the minimum and maximum values.

requirements.text: For front and rear position lamps (functions), depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON, as listed in Table A8-1, except that the luminous intensity distribution at that point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate HV of the lamp (function) under consideration.
requirements.test_case: Measure the rear position lamp intensity 4 s after switch ON at HV and check compliance.

requirements.text: For stop lamps (functions), depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, as listed in Table A8-1, except that the luminous intensity distribution at that point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate HV of the lamp (function) under consideration.
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop lamp intensity 0.2 s after switch ON at HV and check compliance.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps (functions), depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON, as listed in Table A8-1, except that the luminous intensity distribution at that point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate HV of the lamp (function) under consideration.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reversing lamp intensity 0.2 s after switch ON at HV and check compliance.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) uses incandescent technology only, the lamp (function) shall be deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time if the values measured according to paragraph 1.1. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: For an incandescent-only function, confirm compliance of the paragraph 1.1 measurements.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) shall be deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: For the LED-only rear position, stop and reversing functions, confirm compliance of the paragraph 1.2 measurements.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) uses any other light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.test_case: For other light generating technologies, measure from the Table A8-1 time until photometric stability and check compliance.

requirements.text: Where a lamp (function) uses more than one light generating technology, the corresponding intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested following the strictest time requirements according to paragraphs 2.1.1. to 2.1.3. for the combination of them and checked for compliance.
requirements.test_case: For a mixed-technology function, test using the strictest time requirement of paragraphs 2.1.1 to 2.1.3 and check compliance.

requirements.text: If there is doubt (e.g. unexpected run-up behaviour), then the corresponding minimum intensity requirements of the lamp (function) shall be tested and checked for compliance at all points in time starting at the corresponding point in time listed in Table A8-1 and ending when photometric stability is reached.
requirements.test_case: In case of doubt, record intensity continuously from the Table A8-1 time until photometric stability and check the minimum values.

requirements.text: Each retro-reflective device listed in paragraph 1. shall require a separate approval.
requirements.test_case: Check that the integrated retro-reflector holds its own type approval under UN R150, separate from other retro-reflective devices.

requirements.text: The device shall be marked with the approval number assigned to each type approved, following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device for the approval number marked in accordance with paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: If the approval granted in respect of a retro-reflecting device is extended to other such devices differing only in colour, then the two samples in any other colour submitted in conformity with paragraph 3.1.1.1. (d) or 3.1.1.4. of this Regulation shall be required to meet only the colorimetric and photometric specifications, the other tests no longer being required, except that this does not apply to devices of Class IVA.
requirements.test_case: For a colour extension, verify the two samples in the other colour against the colorimetric and photometric specifications.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying a retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) shall be "IA", with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for the examples of figures in Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking for the class symbol "IA" and check the marking size against a = 5 mm minimum.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying a retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) shall be "IB", with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for the examples of figures in Annex 10.
requirements.test_case: Where the retro-reflector is combined with non-watertight signal lamps, inspect the marking for the class symbol "IB" and check a = 5 mm minimum.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for either the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2., or the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Review the drawing and sample to confirm a marking space of sufficient size for the UI or approval marking and the other markings.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect all markings on the device for clear legibility.

requirements.text: The size of the approval marking shall comply with the value for "a" defined in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval marking dimensions and compare with the minimum "a" value of Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle surrounding the letter E and the approving country's number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the four to six-digit sequential number of the approval number.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check on the sample that the sequential number is located close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the retro-reflective device symbol (IA or IB) of paragraph 3.2.5.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments in force at approval.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, if available, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I.
requirements.test_case: If a UI is used, compare the UI mark on the device with the format of Figure I.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Where such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer, a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA shall bear the word "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.
requirements.test_case: If the rotation angle is ambiguous, inspect for "TOP" inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraph 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the device for legibility of the approval marking or UI, the trade name and any "TOP" marking.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the marking shall meet the conditions of paragraphs 3.3.6.1.1. and 3.3.6.1.2.
requirements.test_case: Check that any single approval mark on the rear combination lamp meets the conditions of paragraphs 3.3.6.1.1. and 3.3.6.1.2.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the marking shall be visible after the installation of the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall be so designed that no part that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Review the design and check that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark or UI.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the size of the components of the single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the single approval mark components and compare with the smallest minimum size required by the pertinent Regulations.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Test production retro-reflectors against the requirements of paragraphs 4. and 5.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting device shall meet the requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval.
requirements.test_case: Verify the retro-reflector against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 in force at the time of application.

requirements.text: Where verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible, the retro-reflecting device shall meet the requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed.
requirements.test_case: Check the R48 requirements pertinent to a rear retro-reflector on M1 vehicles that can be verified at device approval.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall be so constructed that it functions satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Verify satisfactory function before and after the prescribed resistance tests.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to its efficient operation or to its maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect samples and design for defects detrimental to operation or maintenance.

requirements.text: The components of the retro-reflective device or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector components by hand without tools and confirm it is not easily possible.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer lens surface over the retro-reflector for ease of cleaning.

requirements.text: The surface shall not be rough.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and feel the outer surface over the retro-reflector to confirm it is not rough.

requirements.text: Any protuberances that the outer surface of the retro-reflective device may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any protuberances on the outer surface and confirm they do not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: While the retro-reflector is in normal use, the inner surface of the retro-reflector shall not be accessible.
requirements.test_case: Check on the assembled lamp that the inner surface of the retro-reflector cannot be accessed in normal use.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector consists of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Check that the prism optical unit and the red filter/lens cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflecting optical units and filters shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.test_case: Review the material specification and inspect that the red colour is not obtained by paint or varnish (e.g. coloured in the mass).
