requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, at an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.test_case: Set up the colorimetric test with CIE Illuminant A, divergence 1/3° and β1 = β2 = 0° (or Annex 4 angle) and record the set-up.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the trichromatic coordinates of the retro-reflected light and compare with the R48 night-time red limits.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is white, the retro-reflective device shall not produce a selective reflection, that is to say, a change of more than 0.01 in the trichromatic coordinates "x" and "y" of Standard Illuminant "A" used to illuminate the retro-reflective device after reflection by the retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: For a white retro-reflector, measure x and y of the reflected Illuminant A light and confirm a change of not more than 0.01.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and measure the retro-reflector shape and dimensions against Annex 5.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric tests per paragraphs 5.1.4. and 5.1.5. in the order of paragraph 5.1.7.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Perform the physical and mechanical tests listed in paragraph 5.1.7. and check results.

requirements.text: When the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5) have been verified, the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Subject all ten samples to the Part 1 of Annex 6 heat resistance test after general and dimensional checks.

requirements.text: When at least one hour has elapsed after the heat resistance test, the ten samples shall be examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: One hour or more after the heat test, measure colour and RI at 20' divergence and β1 = β2 = 0°.

requirements.text: When the ten samples have been examined after the heat resistance test, the two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Perform complete photometry per paragraph 5.1.4. on the samples with the minimum and maximum RI values.

requirements.text: For the first group, the two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: Run the water penetration test then the fuel and lubricant resistance tests on two samples and check results.

requirements.text: For the second group, the two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Run the corrosion test (if necessary) and the rear-face abrasive-strength test on two samples and check results.

requirements.text: For the third group, the two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Run the stability-in-time test of Part 3 of Annex 4 on two samples and check results.

requirements.text: For the fourth group, the two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.test_case: Run the weathering test of Part 6 of Annex 6 on two samples and check results.

requirements.text: When the retro-reflectors in each group have undergone the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: After each test group, check the colour of the samples against paragraph 5.1.5.

requirements.text: When the retro-reflectors in each group have undergone the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4., as verified only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: After each test group, measure the RI of the samples against paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.
requirements.test_case: Check that the reference axis (or range) corresponding to β1 = β2 = 0° is specified for the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Repeat photometry for each specified reference axis or for the extreme axes of the specified range.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements of Class IA or IB retro-reflectors, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter shall be considered.
requirements.test_case: Check that the illuminating surface used for photometry lies within a 200 mm diameter circle.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements of Class IA or IB retro-reflectors, the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2, except that the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.test_case: Measure the illuminating surface used for photometry and confirm it does not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, the manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area of the illuminating surface to be used.
requirements.test_case: Check the drawing for the manufacturer-specified perimeter of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per Part 1 of Annex 4 at all Table 3 angles and compare with the Table 3 minima.

requirements.text: For red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB, the RI values shall be equal to or greater than, at an angle of divergence of 20', 3.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 1.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; and, at an angle of divergence of 1°30', 5∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 2.8∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 2.5∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI of the red retro-reflector at 20' divergence at the three illumination angles and compare with 300/200/100 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: For white retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB, the RI values shall be equal to or greater than, at an angle of divergence of 20', 1.20∙10³ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 8.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 4.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; and, at an angle of divergence of 1°30', 2.0∙10¹ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 1.12∙10¹ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 1.0∙10¹ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.test_case: For a white IA/IB retro-reflector, measure RI at 20' divergence and compare with 1200/800/400 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: For amber retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB, the RI values shall be equal to or greater than, at an angle of divergence of 20', 7.50∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 5.00∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 2.50∙10² mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°; and, at an angle of divergence of 1°30', 1.25∙10¹ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°; 7∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°; and 6.25∙10⁰ mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°.
requirements.test_case: For an amber IA/IB retro-reflector, measure RI at 20' divergence and compare with 750/500/250 mcd/lx.

requirements.text: Within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) and (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°), the RI values shall not be lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Scan RI within the solid angle bounded by (±10°, 0°) and (±5°, ±20°) and confirm no value below the last two Table 3 columns.

requirements.text: Where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: If the intended mounting height is below 750 mm, verify RI downwards only up to 5°.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Perform the night-time colour test of the retro-reflector using the method of paragraph 4.2.1.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected flux and compare with the R48 night-time red limits.

requirements.text: Retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be tested in the chronological order of tests given in Table 4 (Classes IA, IB, IIIA and IIIB).
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the tests were performed on samples a to j in the order of Table 4.

requirements.text: For the heat test of Part 1 of Annex 6, retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C, followed by a visual inspection for distortion.
requirements.test_case: Expose all samples to 65 °C ± 2 °C for 48 h and visually inspect for distortion.

requirements.text: For the water test of Part 3 of Annex 6, retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to 10 min in normal position and 10 min in inverted position, followed by a visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Immerse samples 10 min in normal and 10 min in inverted position and visually inspect for water penetration.

requirements.text: For the motor fuels test of Part 1 of Annex 7, retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to 5 min of exposure, followed by a visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Expose samples to the test fuel for 5 min and visually inspect.

requirements.text: For the oils test of Part 2 of Annex 7, retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to 5 min of exposure, followed by a visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Expose samples to the lubricating oil for 5 min and visually inspect.

requirements.text: For the corrosion test of Part 4 of Annex 6, retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to 24 hours of exposure, a 2 hours interval and a further 24 hours of exposure, followed by a visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Run the salt-spray corrosion cycle of 24 h, 2 h interval, 24 h and visually inspect.

requirements.text: For the rear face test of Part 4 of Annex 6, retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to 1 min of exposure, followed by a visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Apply the rear-face test for 1 min and visually inspect the rear face.

requirements.text: When each test sequence of Table 4 has been completed, retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be checked for colorimetry according to paragraph 4.2. by visual inspection, with trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt.
requirements.test_case: After each test sequence, check colour visually (coordinates if in doubt) and measure RI at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.

requirements.text: When each test sequence of Table 4 has been completed, retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be checked for photometry according to Part 1 of Annex 4, limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: After each test sequence, check colour visually (coordinates if in doubt) and measure RI at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°.

requirements.text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, the presence of any mirror effect shall be ascertained by slightly turning the device.
requirements.test_case: During photometry at β1 = β2 = 0°, slightly turn the device and check for any mirror effect.

requirements.text: If any mirror effect is produced when the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, then a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Where a mirror effect is observed, verify that the RI reading is taken at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is not marked "TOP", the retro-reflective device shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20'.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the non-TOP-marked device about its axis of reference at β1 = β2 = 0° and 20' and record the position of minimum RI.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is not marked "TOP", the minimum RI, measured with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', shall conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare the RI measured at the position of minimum RI with the value required in paragraph 5.

requirements.text: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to the value of ε of minimum RI, except that, if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
requirements.test_case: Check that the RI at the other angles is measured at the ε of minimum RI, rotating by at most ±5° if values are not attained.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is marked "TOP", the retro-reflective device shall be rotated about its axes ±5°, with an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20'.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the TOP-marked device ±5° about its axis at β1 = β2 = 0° and 20' while measuring RI.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is marked "TOP", the RI shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during the rotation of ±5° about its axes.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the RI stays at or above the prescribed value throughout the ±5° rotation.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, then all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.test_case: If the RI at β1 = β2 = 0°, ε = 0° is at least 150 per cent of the requirement, confirm all measurements are made at ε = 0°.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection, the retro-reflective device shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometry report shows illumination with CIE Standard Illuminant A and measurement per Part 1 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB, the shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m and confirm it cannot be confused with a triangle.

requirements.text: Compliance with the specifications of shape and dimensions shall be verified by visual inspection.
requirements.test_case: Perform and record a visual inspection of the retro-reflector shape and dimensions.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C and then allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Store the retro-reflector 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C in dry air, then cool 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C.

requirements.text: When the heat resistance test has been completed, the retro-reflective device and, in particular, its optical component shall show no visible cracking or appreciable distortion.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after the heat test for cracking or appreciable distortion, especially of the optics.

requirements.text: For the water penetration test, the retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Strip removable parts and immerse the device 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the surface.

requirements.text: For the water penetration test, the immersion shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the immersion with the device turned 180° and the rear face covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: When the immersions in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C have been completed, the retro-reflective device sample units shall be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immediately immerse the device under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: When subjected to the water penetration test, the retro-reflective device shall not allow any water to penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: After immersion, inspect the reflecting surface of the optical unit for water penetration.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, then the device shall not be considered to have passed the water penetration test.
requirements.test_case: Record a fail if water is visibly present inside the retro-reflector after immersion.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, then the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: Lightly shake off external water and measure RI at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.

requirements.text: Where the manufacturer requests it, the moisture and dust tests of Part 3 of Annex 6 shall be applied to retro-reflective devices of the Classes IB and IIIB as an alternative to the water penetration test.
requirements.test_case: Where the manufacturer requests it for a Class IB device, check the moisture and dust tests are performed instead of immersion.

requirements.text: For the water spray test, the precipitation rate of the water spray at the device shall be 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min as measured with a vertical cylindrical collector centred on the vertical axis of the rotating test platform.
requirements.test_case: Measure the spray precipitation rate at the device position with the collector and confirm 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min.

requirements.text: For the water spray test, a sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray as specified in paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.6. of Part 3 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Record the initial RI of the mounted sample and subject it to the water spray procedure.

requirements.text: While the water spray test is performed, all drain holes and other openings shall remain open.
requirements.test_case: Check that no drain hole or opening is closed during the water spray test.

requirements.text: Where drain wicks are used, the drain wicks shall be tested in the device during the water spray test.
requirements.test_case: Confirm any drain wicks are fitted in the device during the water spray test.

requirements.text: While the water spray test is performed, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at a rate of 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the platform rotation speed and confirm 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these signalling or lighting functions shall be operated during the water spray test at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Operate the rear position, stop and reversing functions at design voltage in 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycles during the spray test.

requirements.text: The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Check the water spray test duration is 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).

requirements.text: When the water spray test has been completed, the rotation and the water spray shall be turned OFF and the device allowed to drain for 1 hour with the cabinet door closed.
requirements.test_case: Stop rotation and spray and let the device drain 1 h with the cabinet door closed.

requirements.text: When the drain period has been completed, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
requirements.test_case: After draining, inspect the device interior for moisture accumulation.

requirements.text: When the drain period has been completed, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, or be capable of being formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Tap and tilt the device after draining and confirm no standing pool of water forms inside.

requirements.text: When the drain period has been completed, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Dry the exterior with a cotton cloth and measure RI per Part 1 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: For the dust exposure test, the test dust used shall be fine powdered cement in accordance with standard ASTM C 150-84.
requirements.test_case: Check the dust used is fine powdered cement to ASTM C 150-84.

requirements.text: For the dust exposure test, a sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as specified in paragraphs 2.3.5. to 2.3.7. of Part 3 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Record the initial RI of the mounted sample and subject it to the dust exposure procedure.

requirements.text: While the dust exposure test is performed, all drain holes and other openings shall remain open.
requirements.test_case: Check that no drain hole or opening is closed during dust exposure.

requirements.text: Where drain wicks are used, the drain wicks shall be tested in the device during the dust exposure test.
requirements.test_case: Confirm any drain wicks are fitted in the device during dust exposure.

requirements.text: For the dust exposure test, the mounted device shall be placed in the dust chamber no closer than 150 mm from a wall.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the device to the chamber walls and confirm at least 150 mm.

requirements.text: Where the device has a length exceeding 600 mm, the device shall be horizontally centred in the dust test chamber.
requirements.test_case: Where the device is longer than 600 mm, confirm it is horizontally centred in the chamber.

requirements.text: For the dust exposure test, the test dust shall be agitated as completely as possible by compressed air or blower(s) at intervals of 15 min for a period of 2 to 15 s for the duration of 5 hours.
requirements.test_case: Check the agitation log shows 2 to 15 s agitation every 15 min over 5 hours with settling in between.

requirements.text: For the dust exposure test, the dust shall be allowed to settle between the agitation periods.
requirements.test_case: Check the agitation log shows 2 to 15 s agitation every 15 min over 5 hours with settling in between.

requirements.text: When the dust exposure test has been completed, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Clean and dry the exterior with a cotton cloth and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: After the corrosion test, verify RI and colour of the retro-reflector still meet the requirements.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear-face protection (e.g. metallisation) for deterioration after salt mist.

requirements.text: The testing of resistance to corrosion shall be carried out as described in ISO Standard 9227:2017.
requirements.test_case: Check the corrosion test report references ISO 9227:2017.

requirements.text: For the corrosion test, the retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Expose the stripped lamp to salt mist for 2 x 24 h with a 2 h drying interval.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35 °C ± 2 °C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Check the salt mist is atomised at 35 °C ± 2 °C from a 5 per cent NaCl solution in distilled water with at most 0.02 per cent impurities.

requirements.text: When inspected immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Immediately after salt mist, inspect the sample for excessive corrosion that could impair efficiency.

requirements.text: When measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery, measure RA at β2 = 5° and α = 20' and compare with Tables 9 and 10.

requirements.text: For the measurement after the corrosion test, the surface shall be cleaned to remove salt deposits from the saline mist before measuring.
requirements.test_case: Confirm salt deposits are cleaned off the surface before the post-corrosion measurement.

requirements.text: For mirror-backed retro-reflective devices with an accessible rear face, as moulded plastics reflectors of Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA and Advance warning triangle of type 1, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be brushed with a hard nylon brush.
requirements.test_case: Brush the accessible mirror-backed rear face with a hard nylon brush.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA, when the rear face of the retro-reflective device has been brushed, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 (70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol) shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute, after which the cotton cloth is removed and the retro-reflective device left to dry.
requirements.test_case: Apply a cloth soaked in 70/30 n-heptane/toluol to the brushed rear face for 1 min, remove it and let the device dry.

requirements.text: When evaporation is completed, the reverse side shall be brushed with the same brush as before.
requirements.test_case: After evaporation, brush the rear face again with the same nylon brush.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is a moulded plastics reflector of Advance warning triangle of type 1, after having brushed, the reverse side of the retro-reflective device shall be covered or thoroughly wetted for one minute with a mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7, after which the fuel is removed and the device allowed to dry.
When the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink, the RI shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Cover the whole rear face with Indian ink and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.

requirements.text: Where the retro-reflective device is the retro-reflector of an Advance warning triangle of type 1, the RI shall not have diminished by more than 40 per cent of the values recorded before the test, except that this test is not applicable for fluorescent retro-reflecting material.
For the resistance to weathering test, the apparatus shall be in accordance with EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013.
requirements.test_case: Check the weathering apparatus conforms to EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with temperature, humidity control and water spray.

requirements.text: For the resistance to weathering test, the apparatus shall be capable to control temperature and relative humidity.
requirements.test_case: Check the weathering apparatus conforms to EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with temperature, humidity control and water spray.

requirements.text: For the resistance to weathering test, the apparatus shall be equipped with a water spray system.
requirements.test_case: Check the weathering apparatus conforms to EN ISO 4892-1:2016 and EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with temperature, humidity control and water spray.

requirements.text: For the resistance to weathering test, the samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the weathering exposure follows EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with the Table A6-1 parameters.

requirements.text: For retro-reflective devices, the samples shall be exposed to accelerated artificial weathering in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 for a period of 500 hours.
requirements.test_case: Expose the retro-reflector samples to accelerated weathering for 500 hours.

requirements.text: Where a Black-standard thermometer (TM1) is used, the samples shall be exposed according to cycle No. 1 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with an exposure period of 102 min dry and 18 min water spray, an irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² broadband (300 to 400 nm) or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² narrowband (340 nm), a black-standard temperature of 65 ± 3 °C and a relative humidity of 50 ± 10 per cent, as given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: With TM1, check cycle 1 parameters: 102/18 min, 60 ± 2 W/m² (or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² at 340 nm), BST 65 ± 3 °C, RH 50 ± 10 per cent.

requirements.text: Where the samples are fluorescent materials, the samples shall be exposed in accordance with EN ISO 4892-2:2013 using the parameters given in Table A6-1 for a period of 100 hours.

Where a Black-panel thermometer (TM2) is used, the samples shall be exposed according to cycle No. 4 of EN ISO 4892-2:2013 with an exposure period of 102 min dry and 18 min water spray, an irradiance of 60 ± 2 W/m² broadband (300 to 400 nm) or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² narrowband (340 nm), a black-panel temperature of 63 ± 3 °C and a relative humidity of 50 ± 10 per cent, as given in Table A6-1.
requirements.test_case: With TM2, check cycle 4 parameters: 102/18 min, 60 ± 2 W/m² (or 0.51 ± 0.02 W/m² at 340 nm), BPT 63 ± 3 °C, RH 50 ± 10 per cent.

requirements.text: For the test of resistance to fuels, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied to either a retro-reflective device or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking material.
requirements.test_case: Check the fuel resistance test uses a mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol.

requirements.text: For the test of resistance to fuels of a retro-reflective device, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the outer lens and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.

requirements.text: When about five minutes have elapsed after wiping with the test mixture, the surface shall be inspected visually.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the wiped surface about five minutes after wiping.

requirements.text: When about five minutes have elapsed after wiping with the test mixture, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Confirm no apparent surface changes other than slight surface cracks after the fuel wipe.

requirements.text: For moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA and advance warning triangle of type 1, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the outer lens and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil.

requirements.text: When about 5 minutes have elapsed after wiping with the detergent lubricating oil, the surface shall be cleaned.
requirements.test_case: Clean the oiled surface about 5 minutes after wiping.

requirements.text: When the outer surface has been cleaned after the lubricating oil test, the RI shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 after the oil test and compare with the requirement.

requirements.text: The approval number shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the lamp and confirm the approval number is close to the circle around the "E".

requirements.text: The digits constituting the approval number shall face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Check the approval number digits are oriented the same way as the "E".

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Check the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is diametrically opposite the approval number in the mark.
